run.note: This batch covers new cs.RO announcements after the 2026-08-25 scan plus two substantive revisions. Scores are editorial triage and do not publish papers automatically.

candidates.title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators

organization_evidence.evidence: The paper identifies Princeton University in the author header.

asset_checks.evidence: Public repository contains install, training, evaluation, rollout and deployment instructions.
Official URL is stated in the paper; the verifier returned an internal fetch error.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Cross-embodiment action-conditioned video models are evaluated as robot simulators and policy-improvement environments.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv metadata and HTML full text reviewed.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Unifies end-effector, language and latent action representations to train and adapt video world models across human and multiple robot embodiments.

claim_support.evidence: DROID/Bridge/OXE evaluations, real-robot planning and policy-improvement experiments, and controlled baselines were checked.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, experiments, limitations and appendices were reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: CLAP把跨本体视频世界模型从表示问题推进到可部署的统一动作接口，并覆盖零样本真机规划、策略微调与少样本本体适配；代码和模型体系已经公开，是本批最完整的系统工作。
risks_or_uncertainties: 核心训练需要8张80GB级GPU和大规模底层视频数据
部分单本体基线由作者重新训练，跨论文绝对数值仍需谨慎比较

candidates.title: Zero-WAM: In-Context World-Action Modeling from Human Videos for Open-Ended Task Generalization
organizations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

organization_evidence.evidence: Author header lists Robbyant, HKUST (GZ), and HKUST.

asset_checks.evidence: Public repository currently contains paper/project material; code, model and data are scheduled for release before 2026-09-15 and are not counted as available assets.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Direct zero-shot robot manipulation from human video instructions.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv HTML and project page reviewed.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Introduces human-video in-context task specification, HumanGen with 74.2K pairs over 8.6K tasks, and an objective that forces use of the prompt.

claim_support.evidence: Seven held-out RoboTwin tasks, task-level statistics, ablations and real-robot task families were checked.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Data, method, simulation, real-world experiments and discussion reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: Zero-WAM把人类视频变成部署时的任务上下文，而不是只作为预训练数据；七个未见任务平均成功率46.95%，较最强视频动作基线高29.50个百分点，并以HumanGen扩展到8.6K任务。
risks_or_uncertainties: 代码、模型与HumanGen尚未真正发布
真实实验集中在三个任务族，公开页面未给出与仿真同等完整的重复统计
合成人类视频的语义与物理筛选依赖闭源生成模型

candidates.title: GaussianDream++: Efficient 3D Gaussian World Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
organizations: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

organization_evidence.evidence: Affiliations are explicitly mapped in the paper header.

asset_checks.evidence: Public repository contains runnable GaussianDream code and evaluation tracks, but its README does not yet identify a GaussianDream++ release.
Official URL appears in the paper; the verifier returned an internal fetch error.

embodied_relevance.evidence: 3D world supervision for closed-loop robot manipulation.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Compresses Gaussian state and future prediction into 20 policy-native tokens and removes training-only geometry heads at inference.

claim_support.evidence: LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, shift robustness, latency and real-robot experiments reviewed.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, benchmarks, real-world evaluation and ablations reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: GaussianDream++把训练期3D高斯世界监督压缩为20个策略内token，部署时移除重建与渲染路径；LIBERO 98.6%、LIBERO-Plus 87.8%，真机平均成功率从复现的π0.5的29.2%升至52.5%。
risks_or_uncertainties: 现有仓库明确覆盖GaussianDream，但尚未确认++版本核心实现
真机任务仍是桌面操作，跨平台结论有限

candidates.title: Rapid On-Robot Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Skills: Robot Juggling

organization_evidence.evidence: All authors list RAI; Christopher Atkeson also lists CMU Robotics Institute.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Continual real-robot learning for bimanual dynamic dexterity.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv HTML full text reviewed.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Combines a global prior, local memory model and mutually reachable safety set for minute-scale on-hardware learning.

claim_support.evidence: Five three-ball patterns, precision analysis, safety analysis and physical-learning traces reviewed.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Results, discussion, safety mechanism and methods reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: 这项工作让双臂多指机器人直接在真机上用不到5分钟学习并组合五种三球杂耍模式；价值不在炫技本身，而在展示“差的先验模型+安全局部在线修正”可实现快速持续学习。
risks_or_uncertainties: 没有确认到官方代码或项目页
单一高端硬件系统的结果能否迁移到其他动态技能仍未知
论文缺少独立训练基线在完全相同安全预算下的直接比较

candidates.title: Do Robotic World Models Really Follow Actions? Diagnosing and Aligning Action-Conditioned Generation for Policy Learning
organizations: Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics
University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
The Chinese University of Hong Kong

organization_evidence.evidence: The paper lists six numbered affiliations below the abstract.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Evaluates whether robot world models obey commanded actions and whether that affects policy learning.

incremental_contribution.evidence: WorldEcho exposes off-expert action-following failures; WorldSync targets coverage, representation grounding and intervention effects.

claim_support.evidence: RoboTwin diagnosis, controlled ablations, iterative policy improvement and real-robot results reviewed.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, experiments, ablations and limitations reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: WorldEcho指出现有机器人世界模型在专家轨迹外会忽略动作或生成失真视频，WorldSync再针对这一诊断改进训练；它补上了WAM作为策略模拟器时长期缺失的动作服从评测。
risks_or_uncertainties: 未确认公开代码或评测套件
开放世界、长时程和更多本体仍未覆盖
部分提升依赖作者构造的完整性门控指标

candidates.title: DreamLedger: Where to Refuse World-Model Imagination Using Execution-Settled Credit

organization_evidence.evidence: Authors list the University of Florida departments of Civil and Coastal Engineering and Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Deployment-time trust and gating for robot world-model predictions.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Treats reliability as a persistent execution-settled ledger rather than an instantaneous model confidence score.

claim_support.evidence: Three simulated domains, three model families, Franka hardware logs, calibration and sensitivity analyses reviewed.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Mechanism, all experimental findings and detailed limitations reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: DreamLedger让世界模型的失败经验跨episode持久化，并在再次消费相似预测前定价；跨三种接口与模型的门控把“烧掉的想象”降低62%，且1,062次真机消费均可审计回放。
risks_or_uncertainties: 硬件实验仅限Franka推物且门控与盲用试验不是随机并行对照
空账本保守且依赖部署期积累，不能零样本跨站点迁移
未确认公开实现

candidates.title: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency

organization_evidence.evidence: The paper header lists Siemens, UC Berkeley, Microsoft and ETH Zurich affiliations.

embodied_relevance.evidence: RL finetuning of large robot policies under real inference latency.

incremental_contribution.evidence: ARLI restores near-Markovian state using committed actions and a mid-inference observation during asynchronous policy execution.

claim_support.evidence: Theory, simulated latency sweeps, real manipulation and ablations reviewed.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, proof, experiments and limitations reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: ARLI把VLA推理延迟视为RL状态定义问题，通过已承诺动作和推理中途观测恢复近似Markov结构；在标准RL因延迟完全失效的设置中仍能学习，并覆盖仿真与真机操作。
risks_or_uncertainties: 依赖可拆分VLM骨干与动作专家的策略结构
沿用的DSRL在部分任务上本身可能难以学习
未确认公开实现

candidates.title: TrapVLA: Trapping Vision-Language-Action Models in Configured Failure Modes

organization_evidence.evidence: Four numbered affiliations are stated below the abstract.

asset_checks.evidence: Official URL appears in the paper; the verifier returned an internal fetch error.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Backdoor safety evaluation for robot VLA policies.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Defines controllable configured-failure attacks rather than arbitrary failure, with two benchmarks and an automated fidelity metric.

claim_support.evidence: Trap-LIBERO, Trap-RoboTwin, clean-performance, detection and real-robot demonstrations reviewed.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Task definition, method, simulation, detection analysis and real-world appendix reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: TrapVLA把VLA后门从“让任务失败”推进到“精确控制如何失败”，并给出四类故障、两个基准和自动评测；对实际部署安全而言，这比普通触发式攻击更难察觉也更有警示价值。
risks_or_uncertainties: 论文展示的是攻击能力而非防御方案
尚未确认代码和基准资产公开
真机部分以演示为主，统计强度低于仿真

candidates.title: Riemann-1.0: An Embodied World Action Model for Physical AI

organization_evidence.evidence: The author block identifies Riemann Dynamics.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Unified executable robot policy and action-conditioned multi-embodiment simulator.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Fully causal sequence jointly models multi-view video, robot state and embodiment-specific actions, pretrained progressively on 200K+ hours.

claim_support.evidence: RoboTwin, LIBERO, RoboCasa-365, real-world long-horizon and simulator evaluations reviewed.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Data engine, architecture, training recipe and all experiment sections reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: Riemann-1.0以统一因果序列同时承担机器人策略与多本体视觉模拟器，并把20万小时人类、手持夹爪和机器人数据逐级对齐；三个仿真基准和长时程真机结果都很强。
risks_or_uncertainties: 没有确认到代码、模型或数据入口，200K小时规模难以独立复核
同系列闭源数据与内部训练细节会显著影响公平比较
论文未单列局限性章节

candidates.title: SOLO: Stable Omni-terrain Long-Horizon Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion
organizations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

organization_evidence.evidence: Project page maps the eight numbered affiliations.

asset_checks.evidence: Accessible official page with method, videos, field results and affiliations; no code link found.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Long-horizon perceptive humanoid locomotion on real terrain.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv HTML and project page reviewed.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Cell-query terrain reconstruction and trajectory-aware distillation target compounding perception/control errors.

claim_support.evidence: Reconstruction baselines, curriculum ablations, stress tests and uninterrupted field deployments reviewed.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, simulation, hardware protocols, limitations and appendices reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: SOLO同时修复地形重建过度平滑和逐点蒸馏缺少时序信用两个问题；仿真压力测试97.5%，真机零样本连续行走1.5公里，并公开说明后视盲区与2.5D地形表示限制。
risks_or_uncertainties: 没有公开代码或训练资产
仍由人提供平面速度指令，不是自主导航系统
后向运动盲区、反光透明表面和多层地形仍受限制

candidates.title: MA-VLA: Multi-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Collaboration and Compositional Generalization
organizations: University of Science and Technology of China
The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

organization_evidence.evidence: Paper header lists the participating universities.

asset_checks.evidence: Public repository contains multi-arm code, data processing, training and deployment paths, but README still contains placeholder clone/citation text.

embodied_relevance.evidence: VLA policy for coordinated multi-arm manipulation.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv HTML and official repository reviewed.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Explicit arm-specific atomic prompt assignment plus role shuffling targets unseen compositions of known skills.

claim_support.evidence: RoboFactory, RoboTwin, ablations and real dual-SO101 evaluation reviewed.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, benchmark, experiments and ablations reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: MA-VLA用臂级原子指令和Arm Shuffle显式建模多臂协作的组合泛化，并开放2–4臂训练与部署代码；它补充了看板中单臂VLA占主导的结构性空白。
risks_or_uncertainties: 未见组合任务上的绝对成功率仍不高，论文表中MA-VLA为15.3%
仓库README仍有占位克隆地址和未完成引用信息
高层VLM分解错误会传递给执行器

candidates.title: TemporalFlow-VLA: Learning Physically Grounded Execution History for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
organizations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

organization_evidence.evidence: Affiliations are mapped author by author in the header.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Long-horizon VLA manipulation with execution-history supervision.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Training-only robot-surface temporal flow supervises compact ordered-history queries without deployment-time geometry.

claim_support.evidence: LIBERO, RoboTwin, temporal interventions, latency and real-robot sections reviewed.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, simulation, ablations, efficiency and real-robot evaluation reviewed.

candidates.selection_reason: TemporalFlow-VLA不简单堆历史帧，而用训练期机器人表面时序流监督两个执行历史查询；LIBERO平均97.63%，RoboTwin 12任务为85.5/84.2%，且部署延迟维持单帧编码水平。
risks_or_uncertainties: 未确认代码或项目页
核心增益仍主要来自标准仿真基准，真机统计规模有限
训练需要机器人几何和相机标定，数据管线成本较高
